correctness.rationale: For positive values, all five four-window lower-symbol multiplicities are checked symbolically, forcing exactly 2 or 3 small symbols and larger value twice smaller. For zero-containing alphabets, one-zero or all-zero windows are the only possibilities; sliding-window continuity excludes mixtures, and the zero indicator satisfies \(e_{i+4}=e_i\), giving exactly five infinite sequences. The transition list is exhaustive, and its finite matrix inverse gives the rational generating function; exact characteristic polynomial and primitive seven-state graph yield the Perron growth assertion for every length. The packaged verifier checks the exact finite identities and samples; no extrapolation from enumeration is used as proof.

residual_risks: No claim of priority over unavailable or unindexed pre-2026 binary constraint/counting work. A general finite-type shift calculation may have appeared under an unrelated combinatorial vocabulary.

value.rationale: This resolves the natural minimal nontrivial two-symbol restriction of an explicitly studied max/min sequence condition. It proves a sharp all-zero versus positive alphabet rigidity, complete classification of all binary infinite trajectories, an exact finite-word series and nontrivial entropy polynomial. The distinction between only five zero-containing sequences and uncountably many aperiodic positive ones is structural and was not implied by the known periodic counterexample. No general recurrence theory or large-alphabet result is claimed.
